title.zh: 更改马尼拉市Tondo区若干街道名称的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Names of Certain Streets in the District of Tondo, City of Manila
title.orig: An Act to Change the Names of Certain Streets in the District of Tondo, City of Manila

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1182_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The streets of Pingkian, Kulambo, and Bangkusay in the district of Tondo, City of Manila, shall hereafter be known as Gregorio Perfecto Street, Rosauro Almario Street, and Francisco Varona Street, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1954.
